meta.name: context-optimizer
meta.description: Optimize token usage and context management. Use when sessions feel slow, context is degraded, or you're running out of budget.

copy.tagline: 优化 token 用量和上下文管理，提升会话性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果会话变慢、上下文退化或 token 预算紧张
copy.tagline_en: Optimize token usage and context management for better session performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if sessions are slow, context degraded, or token budget tight

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会主动监控上下文使用率，在超过阈值时建议压缩或重置，并采用更简洁的回复风格（如省略客套话、优先输出代码）以节省 token。
howto.when: 当对话变慢、上下文质量下降或 token 预算紧张时触发。也可通过 /context 命令手动检查使用率，超过 70% 时建议压缩。

say.text: 检查当前上下文使用率。
列出当前启用的 MCP 服务器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will actively monitor context usage and suggest compaction or reset when thresholds are exceeded. It will adopt a more concise response style (e.g., omit pleasantries, prioritize code output) to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when sessions feel slow, context is degraded, or token budget is low. You can also manually check usage via /context; compact if >70%.

say_en.note: Claude runs /context and reports the percentage.
Claude runs /mcp so you can disable unused ones.
